title: Sekai no Owari, kun ni Koishita
description:
Sana Natsukawa is a second year high school girl with a one-sided crush on her childhood friend, Shun. But somehow things just keep getting in the way, and she can never find a chance to talk to him. Suddenly, it seems like fate is finally on Sana's side, as she and Shun become classmates! This is her chance to finally get close to him again! Or so she thinks... when a mysterious boy named Kariya ...

تابع أحداث وتطورات Sekai no Owari, kun ni Koishita مع تحديثات يومية وتجربة قراءة فائقة السلاسة وبدقة عالية حصرياً على موقع مانجا تايم (MangaTime).
